verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers a CLI for running collections/tests from CI (hoppscotch-docs-8, hoppscotch-docs-9) but there is no evidence of declarative config management for API gateway/infrastructure or GitOps-style sync of that config from CI; a GitHub issue explicitly requests git-friendly collection storage and remains open/unaddressed (hoppscotch-comm-9), indicating this capability is not delivered.
